title: Path-bearing issuer returns itself with an added terminating slash
rationale: The other half of R9.4 and the reason the asymmetry with C12 is a measurability fact rather than a preference. Here the left-hand side of the comparison is read literally out of the resource's own `authorization_servers` array: nothing is reconstructed, nothing is lost, and the slash difference really does break the client's discovery chain. The instrument previously applied rstrip('/') here, which silently discarded real MUST violations while C12 was penalising the same class.

spec.quote: The `issuer` value returned MUST be identical to the authorization server's issuer identifier value into which the well-known URI string was inserted to create the URL used to retrieve the metadata.
Comparisons between the two strings MUST be performed as a Unicode code-point-to-code-point equality comparison.
